data_quality.notes: Gold review: Jet2 includes both an underseat item and a 10 kg cabin bag, while hold luggage is dynamically priced by booking path, route, and timing. The main fee traps are airport/gate charges for extra cabin baggage and the stepped excess-weight charge above the purchased hold allowance.

fees.conditions: Small under-seat bag is included; it is checked at airport and boarding gates
One 10 kg cabin bag is included; extra or oversize hand baggage is charged at airport/gate
22 kg hold bag price varies by route, season, and booking path; up to three bags per person

data_quality.notes: Jet2 displays hold-bag prices during booking; each single hold bag has a 32 kg absolute maximum.

fees.conditions: 26 kg hold bag price varies by route, season, and booking path; buy before airport when possible

data_quality.notes: Jet2 prices hold baggage dynamically rather than publishing one fixed route-wide amount; airport purchase should be treated as the riskier path.

fees.conditions: Excess baggage above purchased checked allowance; charged per kg up to 4 kg, then flat fee up to 22 kg

data_quality.notes: Excess weight is charged per kg for the first 4 kg of excess, then a flat fee applies up to the stated allowance.

fees.conditions: Flat excess fee after first 4 kg of excess weight, up to 22 kg total allowance

data_quality.notes: Jet2 publishes a flat airport excess step after the first 4 kg; no single bag may exceed 32 kg.

fees.conditions: Additional or oversized hand baggage beyond free allowance; charged per item at airport or gate

data_quality.notes: Additional or oversized hand baggage beyond the free allowance is an airport/gate fee, not an online add-on.

fees.conditions: Bikes and golf bags are paid extras; other sports equipment depends on space and must be added by contact
